description.value: Honeybee Centre is Western Canada's top commercial honey farm, operating a publicly accessible Country Store in Surrey where visitors can browse and purchase locally produced specialty honeys, bee pollen, propolis, royal jelly, and beeswax candles. Cyclists can stop in to shop and watch honeybees at work in the back of the store. The centre also runs educational tours, workshops, and field trips, making it a genuinely distinctive stop on any Lower Mainland cycling route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and confirms Honeybee Centre as Western Canada's top commercial honey farm with a publicly accessible Country Store in Surrey. The address and website URL match OSM exactly; the phone (604-575-2337) appears on the website but was absent from OSM. The OSM amenity=cafe tag is misleading — the business is a honey farm, retail store, and educational tourist attraction — but Food & Drink is defensible because the store sells edible honey products for purchase.
concerns: OSM amenity=cafe tag is inaccurate; the business is a commercial honey farm, retail store, and educational tourist attraction, not a cafe. The co-present tourism=attraction tag is more appropriate.
OSM has no phone number listed; 604-575-2337 sourced from website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible commercial honey farm and Country Store with a well-developed tourist attraction operation; a distinctive and worthwhile stop for touring cyclists in the Surrey area.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as amenity=cafe, but the business is primarily a commercial honey farm, retail Country Store, and tourist attraction (also tagged tourism=attraction in OSM). Food & Drink is retained as it sells edible honey products, but the cafe designation is inaccurate.
